style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright daylit hall
character: grey office mouse, business tie, round ears, long bare tail, bright eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: a card reader on her tail tip, beeping and shearing a slice off every banknote it touches; two collector mice riding her with receipt rolls - their place is her back and shoulders, never the belt, until 8.0; a receipt tape unrolling behind her; open wallets in a row, notes and coins in them
prop_continuity: the reader stays on her tail all ten seconds; her mouth never touches money; the tape grows longer every window
motion_rule: every window she charges down the belt at the lens, whipping her tail sideways into the next wallet, never sitting; she wrenches, kicks and shakes at the collectors and they keep their grip; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: a bank hall, a belt running straight at the lens lined with open wallets, marble desks both sides, bright ceiling light and hard daylight from a tall window, coins glinting

audio.delivery: flat polite male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: byu-DZHET, PRO-sto, spi-SY-va-yu, ye-GO, KAZH-dy, ME-syats, av-to-ma-TI-che-ski
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 8.0
audio.lip_sync: the mouse talks like a person, jaw and lips open and close clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: reader beeps, paper shear, coin clatter, belt hum

timeline.a: her tail reader beeps and shears a slice off a banknote, the slice flying at the lens
timeline.c: big close on tail and note, push in

timeline.a: she charges at the lens, a collector hammering his receipt roll on her shoulder
still charging, she holds both empty paws wide open at the lens
she wrenches, a collector swinging out sideways on one paw, still gripping her tie
she barrels on, her tail whipping into the next wallet
she drives at the lens, the other collector unrolling tape across her eyes
her tail flips a whole wallet into the air, coins bursting past the lens
she runs on, shaking hard at the collectors
still running, she throws her head into the lens
the tape bursts out behind her in a loop and whips past the lens
she drives at the lens, both collectors beeping wallet after wallet off her back
she kicks a collector into a passing wallet, the lid slamming on him
the tape lashes round her and pins her paws, the belt carries her at the lens between the wallets, her own reader beeping her own tie
timeline.c: low mid to big close, belt sliding at the lens

must_appear: her empty open paws at 1.05; the wallet flipped up with coins at 4.05; the tape lashing her at 8.8; her mouth never touches money
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, letters, numbers, cyrillic, logos, readable text, a static camera, a static wide, she stands still while speaking, she sits in a wallet, a microphone, a human hand, a collector on the belt before 8.0, a collector doing nothing before 8.0, a gap between the mouse and the collectors before 8.0, money in her mouth, props hovering motionless in mid-air, extra limbs, more than one tail, English speech, any word after 8.0
